thread:
Maria (AM): Hey team — Day 0 for Aurelia's trial. Need to lock scope, acceptance metrics, security items, and a simple pricing path. Call tomorrow 10am PT. Can owners please confirm?

Jon (SE): I'm in. I'll cover technical discovery and the eval rubric. Quick ask — what are expected steady QPS and worst-case burst? Any strict p95 SLA?

Priya (Sales Eng): I'll own commercial. Finance needs a token estimate and whether they plan a short commit or trial credits.

Sasha (Security): I'll take the security intake. They've asked about SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM, encryption at rest, customer-managed keys, audit log retention, and SOC2 evidence. Do we have their vendor questionnaire?

Kevin (SolutionsEng): I'll collect prompts and build the eval harness. Requesting 150 representative prompts + 30 edge cases + 50 labeled examples. If prod can't be shared, ask for sanitized or synthetic equivalents.

FinanceBot: Rough hosted estimate for 60k peak/day over 30 days: ~$1.3k. 1-month small Dedicated reserved pool: ~$7.5k. Formal quote requires billing contact.

Maria (AM): Aurelia note: prefers hosted, typical 8k tokens/day, occasional spikes to 60k. SOC2 required, no HIPAA. EU residency not required.

Jon (SE): Proposed acceptance metrics:
- Intent accuracy >= 88% on agreed eval set
- Hallucination < 3% on critical subset
- p50 latency < 300ms, p95 < 600ms for target routes
- Error rate < 1% at target QPS
We should lock label schema and metric owners.

Sasha (Security): Must-haves:
- SSO + SCIM or documented manual onboarding
- Option for KMS + customer key (adds ~5 business days)
- Audit logs default 90 days
- IP allowlisting or VPC peering for private endpoints
I'll prepare a one-pager and list blockers for hosted.

Kevin (SolutionsEng): Eval runner we'll ask them to run or let us run in a sandbox:

```
python redwood_eval.py --prompts aurelia_prompts.csv --labels aurelia_labels.csv --model redwood-hosted-1 --out results.csv
```

If they can't run, we can execute with sanitized data.

Priya (Sales Eng): Action on billing: who is billing contact? If Dedicated, SOW + PO required; provisioning lead time ~2-3 days after SOW.

Maria (AM): Calendar invite created for 2025-04-09 17:00 UTC (10:00am PT). Pre-read link included. Please attach any docs.

Jon (SE): I'll post eval rubric by EOD: label taxonomy, sample sizes, and dispute resolution flow.

Sasha (Security): Two questions for call:
1) SCIM required or optional?
2) Any regulatory clauses beyond SOC2?

Kevin (SolutionsEng): Also request median/99p input lengths, whether streaming is needed, and KV-cache sensitive prompts.

Priya (Sales Eng): I'll prepare a two-path quote: hosted trial vs 1-month reserved Dedicated with trial credit applied. Looping in legal for SOC2 addendum.

Maria (AM): Customer can send a CSV with columns: prompt,label,expected_substrings. They'll try to deliver a sanitized set before the call.

Jon (SE): For metrics ownership proposal:
- Customer: provide labeled ground truth and accept/reject criteria
- Redwood SE: run evals, share dashboards, raw outputs
- AM: final acceptance sign-off
I'll formalize this mapping.

Sasha (Security): Attaching SOC2 PDF and security one-pager to invite. I'll highlight any gaps that could block hosted usage.

Kevin (SolutionsEng): Note: meeting p95 will depend on batch config; I'll propose autoscale and KV TTL defaults.

Priya (Sales Eng): If they opt for customer-managed KMS, that'll change billing and onboarding — I'll include options.

Maria (AM): Action items (owners):
- Kevin: request prompt samples and long-tail examples
- Sasha: prep security checklist and SOC2 + KMS notes
- Jon: draft eval rubric and metric owner map
- Priya: confirm billing contact, prepare two-path quote
- Maria: send invite + pre-reads

calendar-bot: Invite sent to Aurelia contacts. Meeting doc: https://redwood.app/meetings/aurelia-day0

Maria (AM): Thanks everyone — flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
